title: First Amendment To Electricity Service Agreement – AVA Community Energy – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of the First Amendment To Electricity Service Agreement by and between the District and AVA Community Energy, Oakland, CA, formerly known as East Bay Community Energy Authority, for the latter to continue to provide favorable, fixed electricity rates discounted from EBCE's standard electricity rates for District's direct access-eligible electric energy services agreements, in an additional not-to-exceed amount of $5,500,000, increasing the Agreement’s not-to-exceed amount from $2,500,000 to $8,000,000, and extending the term of the Agreement from May 1, 2022  to April 30, 2024, through April 30, 2026 (an additional 729 days). All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: Fund 1 - General Purpose and Fund 12 - Child Development
headline: Adds $5.5M and two years to AVA Community Energy's fixed-rate electricity deal, through April 2026
summary: AVA Community Energy (formerly East Bay Community Energy Authority) will keep providing the district fixed electricity rates that are discounted from its standard rates. The amendment raises the contract's spending limit from $2,500,000 to $8,000,000 and extends it by 729 days, through April 30, 2026. All other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Silicon Valley Paving, Inc. – Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project – Buildings and Grounds Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Silicon Valley Paving, Inc., San Jose, CA, for the latter to remove approximately 6,000 Square Feet (SF) of existing subgrade at 4" of depth across the site. Off haul spoils, pave with two (2) lifts of¾" Hot mix asphalt rolling to compact after each lilt; allow the deep lift to cure for 1 day before tack coating and paving over with the finishing 3" of½" Hot mix asphalt, includes the cost of a lost day of paving, the cost of trucking doubling, and dumping fees for soil, for the Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project, in the amount of $70,066.00, increasing the Agreement not-to-exceed amount from $489,650.00 to $559,716.00. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $70,066 to Silicon Valley Paving's Oakland Tech asphalt job for deeper digging and repaving
summary: This change order adds $70,066 to the contract with Silicon Valley Paving, Inc. for the Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project. The added work is removing about 6,000 square feet of soil to a deeper level, hauling it away, and paving in extra layers, including the cost of a lost paving day and doubled trucking. The contract's spending limit rises from $489,650 to $559,716.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
